pages: Article XXIV compliance — self/parent GitHub reads become committed snapshots

doorman/index.html and classic.html made unauthenticated api.github.com calls
at every visitor's page load: the seed's own agents/ listing, recent commits,
and fork count, plus the same three for a seed's parent_repo (lineage gift).
Now a CI-harvested snapshot under state/ in the identical API-response shape
drives each read; only the private-companion listing and write/auth paths
(Issues API, memory PUT, push-access check) still call the live API, and
those already require a token. New scripts/harvest_gh_snapshots.py + a
harvest-gh-snapshots.yml workflow keep the six state/*.json files fresh from
rappid.json's github/parent_repo fields.
